name: @avatark/context-runtime
description: Canonical Context Runtime: answers 'where is this user right now' for any AvatarK product (current product/organization/experience/narrative/episode/scene/living world/location/practice/reflection/cohort/invitation/avatar). User-scoped, product-agnostic, adapter-driven persistence, explicit source precedence, no inferred or fabricated state.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
